channel.title: Alabama News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama News Network (alabamanews.net)

item.title: Man sentenced after pleading guilty to having child sex abuse material on computer in Montgomery
item.description: A man has been sentenced to six years in federal prison after pleading guilty to having child sexual abuse material on a laptop computer that was recovered in Montgomery.

item.title: Some Could Feel 80 Degree Warmth Late Week
item.description: We're expecting upper 70s to lower 80s for highs Thursday and Friday.

item.title: Strong Tower Church Hosting Two-Day Free Dental Clinic in Montgomery
item.description: The free dental clinic will run from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. on Friday, Feb. 20, and Saturday, Feb. 21, at Strong Tower Church.

item.title: St. James defeats Lee-Scott in Central Regional
item.description: The St. James Trojans defeated Lee-Scott to stay alive in the AHSAA Basketball Post Season.

item.title: A 21 point day by Ellis lifts Montgomery Academy over Lee-Scott
item.description: The Eagles defeated Lee-Scott Academy 62-47 to keep their hopes alive of another state title.

item.title: Eagles come up short against Midfield
item.description: Montgomery Academy comes up short against Midfield 60-30 to finish the season 13-17.

item.title: New Alabama Veterans Resource Center comes to downtown Montgomery
item.description: Gov. Ivey, among others, holds a ribbon cutting for the new Alabama Veterans Resource Center in Montgomery.

item.title: No. 25 Alabama survives Darius Acuff’s huge night and beats No. 20 Arkansas 117-115 in 2OT
item.description: In a double overtime thriller, the Tide takes down No. 20 Arkansas to improve to 19-7 overall on the season and 9-4 in SEC play.

item.title: Montgomery Catholic takes down Bibb County in playoff showdown
item.description: Montgomery Catholic outlasts Bibb County late to survive and advance.

item.title: Pleasant Grove outlasts Trinity to win playoff game
item.description: Trinity comes up short, falls 42-49 to Pleasant Grove.
